inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Publish a successful retained job as a displayed saved result only while its input matches the current input.
sideEffects: Displays a saved result and adds its saved case through the configured result adapter.
limitations: Rejects stale input, an active calculation, expiry or revoked connection. Does not restore mismatching input automatically.
